stance: Inflation pipeline is hot but October CPI eased. Core CPI rose 0.30% m/m (Sep 0.34%) and headline 0.35% (Sep 0.65%), so the energy-led spike is fading. September core PCE was 0.32% m/m (3.12% y/y), 1.1pp above the 2% target and still accelerating, after September PPI of 1.3% headline and 0.7% core. Cuts stay pushed back. A softer view needs core m/m near 0.2% to 0.25% and energy reversal. October y/y CPI and consensus are unconfirmed.
